mapper.select: SELECT sr.*, a.title as activity_title, a.location as activity_location, a.start_time as activity_start_time, a.end_time as activity_end_time FROM service_record sr LEFT JOIN activity a ON sr.activity_id = a.id WHERE sr.user_id = #{userId} AND sr.deleted = 0 ORDER BY sr.service_date DESC, sr.created_time DESC

SELECT sr.id, sr.user_id, sr.activity_id, sr.latitude, sr.longitude, sr.location, sr.service_date, sr.service_hours, a.title as activity_title FROM service_record sr LEFT JOIN activity a ON sr.activity_id = a.id WHERE sr.user_id = #{userId} AND sr.deleted = 0 AND sr.latitude IS NOT NULL AND sr.longitude IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sr.service_date DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(service_hours), 0) FROM service_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT activity_id) FROM service_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1

SELECT location, latitude, longitude, COUNT(*) as service_count FROM service_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1 AND location IS NOT NULL GROUP BY location, latitude, longitude ORDER BY service_count DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1
